content: Add governed workflows for decision-authorized breaking semantic changes and evidence-aware project-knowledge distillation, including transient handoff guidance, durable SC records, complete affected-history synchronization, and machine-enforced closure without creating another archive.

D0025 governs later breaking replacements of established repository meaning through independent SCNNNN records, automatic synchronization of every affected current and historical record, transient handoff to other active sessions, and preservation of raw factual evidence. D0024 remains the SemVer and delivery-coordinate authority and the first completed pre-framework migration.

Stage breakthrough 1ecdfb01497610c5042e12bda4a16839d2b9c734 adds the two workflow skills, SC schema and D0025 contract, exact staged-tree validation, HEAD-only protected-history authorization, monotonic SC lifecycle checks, and bilingual routing v2. Architecture CTest passed 6/6; Agent self-test passed 132 cases; semantic edit self-test passed 21/21; guidance passed 17/17; routing passed 81 cases and 34/34 self-tests; both new skills passed package validation and independent forward tests.
